name: Tanaya Beatty
bio: Tanaya Beatty is a Canadian actress. Her mother is of First Nations descent and her father of Himalayan descent.  She is best known for playing Dr. Shannon Rivera in the American medical drama series The Night Shift, Jacob Black's sister in the Twilight saga, Sandra in the series Blackstone and Caitlin in the series Arctic Air.
